statement: Cerebras claims the CS-4 delivers up to 10 times more throughput per watt than the prior-generation CS-3.
why: Throughput per watt sets how much inference a power-constrained site can serve, so a large generational gain changes the economics of non-GPU inference capacity.

impact.mechanism: Higher throughput per watt lets a fixed power envelope serve more inference, easing the power constraint on capacity additions and improving the competitive position of non-GPU systems.

evidence.source: Cerebras Systems (GlobeNewswire press release, reprinted by Manila Times)
evidence.excerpt: up to 10x more throughput per watt than the CS-3, vastly improving data center economics.

confidence.basis: Self-reported vendor comparison against its own prior generation, published via a press-release wire; no GPU baseline and no independent measurement.
